_comment: Shared vectors for the Rust phone core, the Swift watch core and the Kotlin Wear core. Distances: haversine, R=6371008.8 m. Bearings: initial great-circle, true north, null = no bearing (closer than 1 m or origin at a pole), "any" = not checked.
_comment_status: connection_status: the watch's phone/station lines. snapshot null = none received; age_ms = time since it was received; timeout 15 s. tone is ok|waiting|warn|alert. open_phone_app: show the 'Open the GS app on your phone' hint (only when the phone is unreachable and there is no fresh data). auto_cycle: vertical cycle pager; ops tick (time passes), scroll (user moved to `to` with swipe or Digital Crown/rotary), tap (pause/resume). alerts: items with level alert first, then warn, each group by label.

_comment_direct: Direct link. connection_status: optional route (phone|direct|none, default phone), direct_configured, direct_polling, direct_error; the snapshot is the route's (direct: merged with the phone's pages), direct = the direct-link line or null. link_route: phone fresh = phone snapshot age <= fresh_ms and mode != no_station; route phone when fresh, else direct when its age <= fresh_ms, else the newer of the two, else none; poll = foreground && configured && !phone fresh. action_outcome: HTTP status/body/network error of POST /api/command -> accepted|refused|unknown and the text shown. action_button: what a page action button shows. page_layout: pages the watch renders from settings (items, at most 2 actions per page truncated first, then only actions the phone published on any page). provision: phone -> watch direct-link message. direct_status.item_ids: GS /api/watch/status items (GS watch.rs mirrors the phone registry).

_comment_map: Map background (docs/watch-companion.md "Map background"). Web Mercator XYZ tiles, 256 px, lat clamped to +-85.05112878, span_m = 2*pi*6378137*cos(lat)/2^z. tile_xy: fractional tile coordinates (tol 1e-9) and the containing tile's bounds (tol 1e-9 deg). coverage: per level (z clamped to max_zoom, duplicates keep the larger radius, low zoom first), per centre in order, every tile whose index lies in floor(f -+ radius_m/span_m), ordered by round(squared distance of the tile centre from the point in tiles * 1e6), then y, then x; duplicates skipped; then the first max_tiles. budget: greedy in plan order, a tile (size>0) is kept when the running total stays <= cap. manifest_diff: plan tiles the watch does not have, in plan order. evict: tiles outside the current plan first, then least recently used, then by key, until total <= cap. auto_fit: zoom placing distance_m at radius_px from the centre, clamped (tol 1e-9). ancestor: nearest available ancestor (up to 6 levels) and the sub-square of it (fractions). replan: no centres -> false; no previous -> true; age > max_age -> true; different ids -> true; any centre moved > move_m (haversine) -> true. visible: integer zoom = floor(zoom+0.5), tile_px = 256*2^(zoom-z), tiles covering the view's circumscribed circle, offsets from the view centre in px (tol 1e-6). project: px offset of a point from the centre at a fractional zoom (tol 1e-6).

manifest_diff.name: send only missing, in plan order

evict.name: old area first, then least recently used

_comment_voice: Crew voice on the watch (docs/watch-companion.md 'Voice'). ptt: press-and-hold or tap-to-toggle state machine; send is the transmitting control to send (null: none), haptic the feedback to play (the app applies the haptics settings). backoff: reconnect delay = floor(min(base*2^(attempt-1), cap) * (0.75 + 0.5*jitter)). transport: direct to the GS, else relayed by the phone. frames: binary framing (LE u32 speaker id + payload). mix: playout buffer per speaker, integer sum*volume_pct/100 truncated toward zero, clipped to i16.
